results.description:
Ever wanted to build an AI agent that actually ships? Not a demo in a notebook, but something running live on the internet with a URL you can share.

In this hands-on workshop, you'll build and deploy an interactive AI Barista for a coffee shop, using Google's open-source Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Gemini. You'll ground the agent in a real menu so it answers from actual data, then deploy it to Cloud Run so it runs in production, not just on your laptop.

Python, RAG, agents, and deployment. All in one evening.

📅 Sunday, 25 October 2026
🕕 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM
📍 Google Cloud Turkey Center of Excellence, Street 503, Istanbul

💻 Bring a laptop, Python basics, and a Google account. You'll be building from the first minute.

🎟️ Seats are limited - reserve your spot:
results.description_short: Join a hands-on workshop to build and deploy a live AI Barista using Google's ADK and Gemini. Learn to ground the agent in real menu data and deploy on Cloud Run. Perfect for those with Python basics. Happening Sunday, 25 October 2026 from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM at Google Cloud Turkey Center in Istanbul. Bring your laptop and Google account. Seats are limited, so reserve your spot.
results.title: Tech Talk: Deploy a RAG AI Agent in Python using Google ADK and Cloud Run
